<DESCRIPTION>
Uses win-stay/lose-shift to restore cooperation after short conflicts, while switching to persistent defection when the opponent has defected for three consecutive rounds. This retains protection against always-defect opponents while avoiding permanent retaliation after isolated defections.
</DESCRIPTION>

<CODE>
```python
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def policy(own_history, opponent_history):
    return 0 if len(opponent_history) == 0 else 1 if len(opponent_history) >= 3 and opponent_history[-3:] == (1, 1, 1) else 0 if own_history[-1] == opponent_history[-1] else 1
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
```
